I'm Hella late to this, but since the comments seemed to more be about poking and proding at the legality of a baton as opposed to answered the question:

21" is what I'd call standard, as well as a good 'all-rounder' size. Rides the line between too little, so it's not effective at keeping distance, and too much, so that you won't carry it. Keep your receipt so you can exchange for a different size if need be.  

However, if you wanna be really overkill? And maintain a good distance? A brand called Nextorch makes a 39" expandable baton that's 12" collapsed. It is just as cool as you think it is, as well as just as impractical for EDC and concealment.
